combined_endpoint_rule.TRADEOFF: stock_delta < 0 and face_down_delta > 1, or face_down_delta < 0 and stock_delta > 0
combined_endpoint_rule.WIN: stock_delta < 0 and face_down_delta <= 1, or face_down_delta < 0 and stock_delta <= 0
combined_endpoint_rule.delta_definition: guarded minus N8; negative is improvement

verdict_rule.BALANCES: P2 and P7 both improve stock, both retain at least half their historical face-down advantage, and active subset has at least two WINs
verdict_rule.HARMS: at least two active deals are LOSS
verdict_rule.INERT: no withheld events, or both P2 and P7 are NEUTRAL
verdict_rule.OVER_SUPPRESSES: at least one P2/P7 stock recovery, but every recovered deal loses its entire historical face-down advantage
